content: 1. GRAMMAR: Parallel Structure — Fix these thesis statements to have parallel structure: a) 'Children should not have smartphones because addiction, they get distracted, and because of online dangers.' b) 'Smartphones are harmful due to mental health effects, cyberbullying occurs, and there are academic problems.'

2. THESIS EVALUATION: Rate these thesis statements 1-3 (3=excellent): a) 'Smartphones are bad for kids.' b) 'Children should not have smartphones because of risks.' c) 'Children under 12 should not own smartphones because they increase mental health risks, expose them to online dangers, and reduce academic performance.'
3. CAMBRIDGE PET Writing: Write a 50-word introduction to an essay titled 'Should children be allowed to use social media?'

parts.title: PART 1: READING INPUT  ARGUMENTATIVE ESSAY INTRODUCTION
content: An argumentative essay introduction differs from a report introduction. While a report introduction is neutral and informational, an argumentative introduction TAKES A POSITION from the very beginning.
1. HOOK — A compelling opening: use a statistic, a scenario, or a provocative question.
2. CONTEXT — 2 sentences establishing the current situation (neutral, factual).
3. CONTROVERSY — 1 sentence acknowledging the debate: 'This issue divides experts and parents alike...'
4. THESIS STATEMENT — Your clear position with 3 supporting reasons.
'Although [acknowledge opposing view], children under 12 should [NOT] be allowed smartphones because [reason 1], [reason 2], and [reason 3].'
